intro.eyebrow: Happy Hour at Coco Maya, Little Italy
intro.title: Rooftop Happy Hour, Mon–Fri 4–6 PM
intro.body1: Happy hour runs Monday through Friday, 4:00–6:00 PM, on Coco Maya's elevated glass atrium patio on India Street in Little Italy. A dedicated menu of shareable bites and house cocktails, designed for the hour between the workday and the evening.
intro.body2: Walk-ins are welcome during happy hour. Reservations are recommended if you're bringing a group.

patioFeature.label: The Rooftop Patio
patioFeature.title: The Rooftop Patio at Happy Hour, Little Italy
patioFeature.body1: Pink umbrellas, string lights, and the glass atrium roof overhead. This is where Little Italy comes to unwind after work.
patioFeature.body2: Grab a seat at the bar or claim a table under the umbrellas. Either way, it's the best hour of the workday.
